title: Channels, store-and-forward and transport seam
summary: Remote queue definitions map application alias to remote manager/queue/transmission queue/sender channel. Channel retry uses RELEASE, preserving application backout semantics. Socket transport is a separate seam; queue.transport/2 details belong in the dedicated Queue Transport sphere.
invariants: Do not make channel retry look like application NACK/backout.
Receiver acceptance is idempotent by transferId.
Transport confidentiality/authentication does not move queue/application authority into the socket layer.
